title: The Cold Terminal
author: Jude Sterling
blurb: Ines Pemberton, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
